name: Starburst slows the attack speed of enemies it hits by 20% (#2401)
contract: Starburst 801996 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, cooldown 20000, instant, Arcane) has effect 2 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (64) with TriggerSpell 704796 on the same source-area enemy targets as its damage effect; Spell::EffectTriggerSpell in launch-target mode casts the triggered spell on each hit unit. Its description reads '... reducing their attack speed by $704796s1% for $704796d.' The debuff 704796 (record named Starburst, rank text 'ATS Slow', duration index 1) has effect 0 APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (192), EffectBasePoints -21 with DieSides 1 resolving to -20, and aura description 'Attack speed slowed by $w1%.' (issue #2401 is this debuff spell id; the classification report numbers the effect from 1). Aura 192 is the stock haste handler AuraEffect::HandleModMeleeRangedSpeedPct, which rescales the swing timer through Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod: a negative amount takes the else branch of ApplyAttackTimePercentMod and multiplies the timer by (100 + 20) / 100 = 1.20 (a positive haste amount divides instead, which is why Starbarian reads 1/1.04). The module edits 801996 only for its damage base value (block value bonus, AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp) and a crit chance bonus (AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp); nothing touches 704796. The caster has spell_hit_rating 10000 so the cast cannot miss; the enemy is a hostile (faction 14) level-80 fixture creature 3 yards away, inside the spell's area. Not asserted: that the debuff drops after its 10 second duration, and exact slow on a creature whose template attack time is zero (the ratio snapshot would then fail loudly).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Cast Starburst at the adjacent enemy
Starburst's triggered debuff 704796 lands on the enemy, cast by the caster
The enemy's swing timer is 20% longer (x1.20)
